steps: Check for unusual sounds or vibrations
Inspect for visible damage or leaks

description: Replace hydraulic oil and filter to maintain system performance
steps: Shut down machine safely and allow to cool
Replace oil filter with new one
Fill with recommended oil type and grade
Check oil level and top up if needed
Test operation and check for leaks
Document oil change in maintenance log

description: Inspect conveyor belt condition and adjust tension
steps: Inspect belt for wear, cracks, or damage
Check belt tension using tension gauge
Check belt tracking and adjust if needed

description: Clean and lubricate CNC spindle for optimal performance
steps: Clean spindle taper with appropriate cleaner
Run test program to verify operation

description: Replace compressor air filter to maintain efficiency
steps: Shut off compressor and release pressure
Install new filter ensuring proper seal

description: Detailed inspection of all machine components
steps: Complete visual inspection of all components
Verify calibration of sensors and controls
Document all findings and schedule repairs
